caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be an old-fashioned, hand-operated mechanical tool. It is colored in shades of brown and gray, giving it a weathered or metallic appearance. The tool consists of a long, flat, oval-shaped upper plate attached by a hinge to a rectangular lower base, with a visible metal spring mechanism connecting the two plates near the hinge. There are two brown handles emerging from the back of the lower base, curved ergonomically for gripping, and a visible, decorative, reddish-brown metal component near the left side of the base, which is shaped somewhat like a star or a gear. The object is placed centrally on a plain, light beige background with a faint, scattered presence of small brown spots in the upper and lower areas. The drawing includes the artist’s signature, “Albert Ruduier,” in small script to the lower right of the tool.
title: Bootjack
